answer:
The newest release notes I have that cover Muse Glimmer are v0.32.8, not v0.32.15. They say it runs on all platforms: "Muse Glimmer is now available on all platforms." [ollama/v0.32.8.md]

The same release's change list adds: "Add Muse Glimmer support for NVIDIA, AMD, and additional platforms" [ollama/v0.32.8.md]. That follows the earlier v0.32.7 note, which said support was initially limited to Apple Silicon through the MLX engine: "Muse Glimmer is currently available via initial support via Ollama's MLX engine on Apple Silicon." [ollama/v0.32.7.md]

I don't have the notes for v0.32.9 through v0.32.15, so I can't say whether they change this.
